name: Malaysia Transformer Manufacturing (MTM)
description: Malaysian transformer manufacturer and wholly owned Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB) subsidiary: distribution, power, dry-type and generator transformers from 100 kVA to 100 MVA, plus remanufacturing, retrofit and refurbishment services to 275 kV. Serves TNB, SESB, IPPs and the oil and gas sector.
products: distribution transformers (to 5,000 kVA, 33 kV class per company history)
